title: Fox Run Cotton Cheese Cloth, 2 Yards, White
description:
About this item
Made of 100% natural cotton - high quality, reliable and biodegradable cotton fiber
Durable and reusable - contains 2 Square yd. Of strong, 100% natural White cotton fabric that can be washed and re-used; save money while being eco-conscious
Many household uses: straining stocks, canning, stuffing poultry, protecting fish and chicken while poaching, catching seeds from juicing, or wrapping spices; also useful when making hard and soft cheese
Cure and age meats: cheesecloth wicks away water and allows unwanted moisture to escape for perfectly cured meats and salami
Lint free, soft & absorbent - no tiny bits or residues; use with complete confidence, also great for cleaning and dusting around the house
